name: Nebula Revelation
rootCause: On January 25th, the staking contract of the space-themed open-world Web3 game Nebula Revelation suffered a reentrancy attack. On January 28th, Nebula Revelation announced a compensation plan of 159,831 USDT. The team promises comprehensive compensation and has decided to reimburse users at the price before the theft to ensure fairness.

descriptions.text: On January 25th, the staking contract of the space-themed open-world Web3 game Nebula Revelation suffered a reentrancy attack. On January 28th, Nebula Revelation announced a compensation plan of 159,831 USDT. The team promises comprehensive compensation and has decided to reimburse users at the price before the theft to ensure fairness.

Nebula Revelation's staking contract was exploited on Optimism on January 25, 2024, through a reentrancy vulnerability in its withdrawal function, leading to losses of about $180,264 (~81.3 WETH). The attacker used a self-destructing contract to facilitate the exploit, then bridged stolen funds to Ethereum. The Nebula Revelation team later announced a compensation plan. Absence of reentrancy protection in the staking contract’s withdrawal logic allowed the attacker contract to make repeated calls and drain funds in a single transaction.
